question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"insulator."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • An **"insulator"** is a material that does not conduct electricity or heat. (ताप, विद्युत या ध्‍वनि रोधक यंत्र) • **Example**: *Generally, plastics tend to be good **insulators**__.* • It is used to prevent the flow of electricity or heat between two objects or areas. • In the given context, an insulator would be the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2. • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct paragraph: English Ivy __betrays__ its poor reputation as a nuisance by its unparalleled ability to provide shade. By seamlessly covering the exterior of a building, it works as a natural __**insulator**__, blocking the sun and decreasing air conditioning costs. This means big savings for both building tenants and homeowners ______ (3) ______. And it can happen quickly, too. Under the proper conditions, established English Ivy can grow to cover ______ (4) ______ of roughly 500 square feet per year. Given that most homes have a roof measuring roughly 2000 square feet, ivy-friendly homeowners can rest assured that their roofs will be ______ (5) ______ covered in about four years. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1, **"modulator"**, refers to a device that changes the amplitude or frequency of a signal. (एक उपकरण जो सिग्नल के आयाम या आवृत्ति को बदलता है) • Option 2, **"postulator"**, means a person who postulates something. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी बात का अनुमान लगाता हो) • Option 4, **"regulator"**, refers to a device or mechanism that controls or maintains a certain level or rate of something. (एक उपकरण या तंत्र जो किसी चीज़ के एक निश्चित स्तर या दर को नियंत्रित या बनाए रखता है) 44:Tda9, The correct answer is **"alike."**
